evals.title: AI patient summary
evals.prompt: Design an AI-generated patient summary inside a chart with source-link capability.
evals.expected_output: Generated label, source anchors, secondary placement to authoritative record and explicit complete/loading state.
assertions: The AI job is task-specific rather than a generic chat affordance.
Generated output is visually distinguishable from source record.
Provenance is exposed when available and verification matters.
Confidence/uncertainty is not fabricated.
Proposed and executed actions are distinct.
Loading/failure states cannot masquerade as complete authoritative output.
